Orchestration Pipeline

Step through the top-level orchestration net that routes requests to sub-pipelines. Select an action and watch it route through the Petri net. The net routes four actions. Three of them take a self-contained payload and are offered below. The fourth, store_decomposition, is step 2 of ingest: its payload is the segment ids that segment returns, plus the topics, facts and inferences an agent extracted from them, so it cannot be driven from a text box. tests/pipelines/test_orchestration.py shows the two steps chained.
